note: 30-product Phase-0 gold seed. Expected bands derived from first-principles nutrition + physical label (direct product scrape). Independence firewall: no engine score/grade/dimension output was consulted when authoring expected{}. OFF-ban: no Open Food Facts values anywhere. Grade cutoffs: S>=90, A 80-89, B 65-79, C 50-64, D 35-49, E 0-34. Dimensions are advisory only (max 3 per entry, label-observable only). Data-gap entries (A02, A05, A06, A07, A08, A09, A10, P09) resolved from BSIP1 normalized_nutrition_per_100g fields; where null, noted as null with reason.
